newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Hitech group Coms21 to list Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Hitech group Coms21 to list Wednesday.

text.p: High technology design group, Coms21 Ltd will make its debut on the Australian Stock Exchange on Wednesday.
The company made an initial public offering of 18 million shares at 55 cents each to raise A$9.9 million, an offering which closed oversubscribed on January 3.
Coms21 is involved in the development and commercialisation of smartcard control management systems, wide-area link jackpot systems and interactive television games, gaming and wagering.

Formed in 1992, Coms21 has developed control management systems based on microprocessor and smartcard technology for use in secure storage and retrieval of information and photographic images under the Key Control brand label.
The company has also developed a wide-area link jackpot system called Supa-Link for which, subject to legislative approvals, will initially be used in the Australian Capital Territory (ACT).

Coms21's subsidiary, NTN Australasia Pty Ltd (NTN) is a licensed supplier of NTN Communications Inc, interactive sports and trivia games for use in interactive television in Australia and New Zealand.
NTN's broadcast centre in Sydney currently delivers interactive programmes to over 120 clubs and hotels in New South Wales, Queensland and the ACT via a television signal.
